thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-4821 triggered — elevated SRV lookup errors and service-discovery 5xx for eu-west-3 (az-c). Symptoms: internal service-to-service calls failing with lookup timeouts and 502/504 from proxy. Alert group: infra-consul-coreDNS.
oncall-jess: i'm on it, pulling logs and metrics now. switching pager to me.
raj: i'm seeing ~12% of SRV lookups fail for internal-api across az-c. consul grpc proxied errors, logs show `connection refused` to consul-leader-ip:8300 intermittently.
sofia: net-eng — any network changes in eu-west-3 az-c in the last 30m?
net-eng-mike: nothing planned. saw transient egress route flap at 02:18 UTC followed by partial reconverge. BGP shows a few withdraws on the az-c egress pairs, still investigating with cloud provider.
eli: CoreDNS pods in az-c show repeated OOMKilled restarts around 02:19-02:22 UTC. `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=coredns -o wide` shows many on CrashLoopBackOff then back to Running. logs:```time="2026-03-15T02:20:12Z" level=error msg="plugin/errors: 2 2.2.2.2:53-: read udp 10.0.4.7:53381->2.2.2.2:53: i/o timeout"```
oncall-jess: that matches the SRV lookup timeouts. hypothesis: upstream network egress flap -> CoreDNS can't reach consul upstreams -> service discovery failures.
support-ops: customer-impact note: internal telemetry shows elevated error rates for EU tenants' background jobs and some user-facing slow API responses. approx 4-6% of requests from eu-west region saw transient errors during window. notifying sales and CS for impacted customers list.
raj: i can force-consul-fallback to local catalog for reads while we stabilize. doing `consul catalog services -wan` fallback isn't ideal but reduces cross-node leader lookups.
net-eng-mike: cloud provider reports partial routing reconverge; they're re-announcing prefixes to the peering. ETA 6-8 minutes.
oncall-jess: mitigation plan: 1) scale CoreDNS replicas in az-c (from 3 -> 6) 2) bump memory limits to avoid OOM for now 3) add short consul read cache on proxies 4) monitor error budget and revert if side effects. I'll coordinate.
eli: scaling now — `kubectl -n infra scale deploy coredns --replicas=6` then patching memory limits:```kubectl -n infra patch deploy coredns -p '{"spec": {"template": {"spec": {"containers": [{"name":"coredns","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"512Mi"},"requests":{"memory":"256Mi"}}}]}}}}'```
sofia: net-eng updated — provider reports route stabilized at 02:27 UTC, no further withdraws.
raj: enabling consul proxy local cache on service proxies: editing config and issuing restart for proxy sidecar on a subset (canary) of services. command: `consul connect proxy -sidecar-for service -- --cache-ttl=30s` — applying to internal-api canary first.
oncall-jess: oncall takeover — handing off to oncall-takeover for observation window (30m). I've documented steps and current state in the incident board.
oncall-takeover: acknowledged. I'll watch for 30m and escalate if error rate > 1% sustained.
support-ops: opened customer incident page and added customers with >1% error exposure. sending initial comms: "We observed transient service discovery errors in eu-west-3 between 02:18–02:28 UTC leading to elevated errors for some EU traffic; mitigation applied. We'll update when stable."
eli: logs after scale show far fewer OOMs and CoreDNS queries succeeding:```2026-03-15T02:29:03Z INFO plugin/forward: upstream 2.2.2.2:53 responded in 12ms```
raj: consul proxy cache reduced lookup volume to leader — success on canary. rolling out to remaining internal-api instances.
net-eng-mike: provider confirmed no ongoing route withdraws and traceroutes look stable.
oncall-takeover: error rate dropped to 0.6% over the last 10m, p95 latency back to baseline. marking incident as mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident updated — P-4821 moved to MITIGATED by oncall-takeover. timeline and runbooks attached to incident ticket.
support-ops: prepping postmortem comms and customer follow-up.
oncall-jess: follow-ups (for postmortem): - verify memory pressure cause on CoreDNS (pod metrics) - add autoscaling rule for CoreDNS by rss/memory + add a short-term extra replica buffer in az-c - review consul proxy cache defaults and make safer fallback behavior - add network egress monitoring alert tied to BGP withdraws -> service discovery impact.
oncall-takeover: leaving notes in the ticket; will hand back to jess for postmortem. closing slack thread but will reopen if regressions appear. :white_check_mark:
